objective: Review the immutable leo_sim_v2 formal smoke package and its dedicated governance-to-remote execution path before any VM launch.
context: The smoke is an integration gate for direct endpoint-to-satellite access, finite K=1 access, control-plane propagation, GE evaluation, non-oracle hop routing, natural completion, receipts and conservation.
The smoke uses BBM. It does not claim MBB effectiveness, outage occurrence, algorithm superiority, calibrated operator realism, or production readiness.
excluded_inputs: Prior agent completion claims without direct source evidence
deliverables: Three independent review receipts bound to every compiled experiment artifact
A decision and finalization that either accept or block authorization
cannot_claim: No VM execution has occurred before authorization.
No mechanism effect, speedup, DDQN result, MBB effectiveness, outage frequency, or operator-calibrated realism is established by this package.
acceptance: The experiment request, resolved config, manifest, analysis request and runbook form one internally consistent immutable build.
The V2 path cannot silently invoke or fall back to the legacy Gateway runtime.
Authorization binds exact artifact, code, config, trace-input and run identities.
The formal remote runner invokes only CODE.leo_sim and requires natural-end receipt verification plus requested-mechanism effectiveness before research_eligible=true.
Any blocking correctness, simulation-validity or governance finding causes REVISE rather than authorization.
